Name: Marcille Portraits Replace Leah -  Delicious in Dungeon (Dungeon Meshi)
Author: r2elles
Description:
Hi everyone! This is the first portrait I've ever made, so I'm very new and would love feedback. Here's Marcille to replace Leah, because I don't know how to create new characters yet. This is just a png file, and you'll need to replace the files yourself. To do this, I usually take a pre-existing portrait replacement mod, then rename and switch the files out.

I'm still working on her sprites, but hopefully I can update this with that soon. I hope to make the rest of the dungeon meshi crew eventually as well. 
Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Portrait only, sprites to come in future
